requestBody.description:
To charge the card directly, make a Sale transaction. Upon successful Sale transaction,
                funds are transferred from the cardholder to the merchant, and a transaction record is created.
                In some cases, a 3DS authentication procedure is required to successfully complete such an action.
                For more details, please refer to [`3DS required`](#webhooks--3ds-authentication-required).
                After processing the request, a webhook will be sent to your URL specified in the Processing Account setup.
                For more details, refer to the [`Sale`](#webhooks--sale) webhook.

To authorize an amount and charge the card later, make an Authorize transaction.
                Upon successful Authorize, funds are reserved in the cardholder's account, and a transaction record is created.
                In some cases, a 3DS authentication procedure is required to successfully complete such an action.
                For more details, please refer to [`3DS required`](#webhooks--3ds-authentication-required).
                To charge the authorized amount, make a Capture transaction by providing the initial Authorize transaction ID.
                See [`Capture`](#actions--capture) for details.
                After the request is processed, a webhook will be sent to your URL specified in the Processing Account setup.
                For more details, refer to the [`Authorize`](#webhooks--authorize) webhook.

To authorize an amount and have the ability to authorize an additional amount later, make a Pre authorize transaction.
                Upon successful Pre authorize, funds are reserved on the cardholder's account and a transaction is created.
                In some cases, a 3DS authentication procedure is required to successfully complete such an action.
                For more details, please refer to [`3DS required`](#webhooks--3ds-authentication-required).
                To authorize an additional amount, make an [`Incremental authorize`](#actions--incremental-authorize) transaction by providing the Pre authorize transaction ID.
                To charge this authorized amount, make a Capture transaction by providing the Pre authorize transaction ID.
                See [`Capture`](#actions--capture) for details.
                After processing the request, a webhook will be sent to your URL specified in the Processing Account setup.
                For more details, refer to the [`Pre authorize`](#webhooks--pre-authorize) webhook.

To move funds from the merchant's account to the cardholder's account, make a Credit transaction.
                    After processing the request, a webhook will be sent to your URL specified in the Processing Account setup.
                    For more details, refer to the [`Credit`](#webhooks--authorize--registeredcreditaddress) webhook.

To process a transaction without cardholder details, use card hash received in the webhook response of any previous API call.
                Depending on the provided operationType, three actions can be done: [`Authorize`](#actions--authorize), [`Sale`](#actions--sale) or [`Credit`](#actions--credit) request.
                In some cases, a 3DS authentication procedure is required to successfully complete such an action.
                For more details, please refer to [`3DS required`](#webhooks--3ds-authentication-required).
                After processing the request, a webhook will be sent to your URL specified in the Processing Account setup.
                For more details, refer to the [`Process`](#webhooks--process) webhook.

To transfer funds from one cardholder's account to another cardholder's account, make a P2P transaction.
                Person-to-person (also known as Peer-to-Peer or P2P) transactions are electronic funds transfers from one person to another through an intermediary,
                typically referred to as a P2P payment application.
                After processing the request, a webhook will be sent to your URL specified in the Processing Account setup.
                For more details, refer to the [`P2P`](#webhooks--p2p) webhook.
                In some cases, a 3DS authentication procedure is required to successfully complete such an action.
                For more details, please refer to [`3DS required`](#webhooks--3ds-authentication-required).

To release the authorized amount reserved on the cardholder's account, make a Cancel transaction by providing the transaction ID of the initial
                    [`Authorize`](#actions--authorize) or [`Pre Authorize`](#actions--pre-authorize) request.
                    You can also perform multiple cancellations for authorizations with partial amounts.
                    After processing the request, a webhook will be sent to your URL specified in the Processing Account setup.
                     For more details, refer to the [`Cancel`](#webhooks--authorize--registeredcanceladdress) webhook.

To cancel a recurring transaction which was initiated with the
                    [`Authorize`](#actions--authorize) or [`Sale`](#actions--sale) request,
                    make the Cancel Recurring request by providing the initial transaction ID of a previous [`Authorize`](#actions--authorize) or [`Sale`](#actions--sale) request.
                    After processing the request, a webhook will be sent to your URL specified in the Processing Account setup.
                    For more details, refer to the [`Cancel recurring`](#webhooks--authorize--registeredcancelrecurringaddress) webhook.

To charge the authorized amount reserved on the cardholder's account,
                    make a Capture transaction by providing the transaction ID created with a previous [`Authorize`](#actions--authorize) or [`Pre authorize`](#actions--pre-authorize) request.
                    Upon successful Capture, funds are transferred from the cardholder to the merchant. You can charge the specified amount either partially or fully.
                    After processing the request, a webhook will be sent to your URL specified in the Processing Account setup.
                    For more details, refer to the [`Capture`](#webhooks--authorize--registeredcaptureaddress) webhook.

To authorize an additional amount later, make an Incremental authorize transaction.
                    Upon successful Incremental authorize, additional funds are reserved on the cardholder\s account, and a transaction is created.
                    To charge the authorized amount, make a Capture transaction by providing the Pre authorize transaction ID. See [`Capture`](#actions--capture) for details.
                    After processing the request, a webhook will be sent to your URL specified in the Processing Account setup.
                    For more details, refer to the [`Incremental authorize`](#webhooks--authorize--registeredincrementalauthorizeaddress) webhook.

To refund up to the amount of the received payment,
                    make a Refund transaction by providing the transaction ID created with a previous [`Capture`](#actions--capture) or [`Sale`](#actions--sale) request.
                    After processing the request, a webhook will be sent to your URL specified in the Processing Account setup.
                    For more details, refer to the [`Refund`](#webhooks--authorize--registeredrefundaddress) webhook.

typeOf3ds.description:
[`3DS Type`]
KEY 3DS Type Description
1 Attempt 3DS Processing transactions regardless card enrollment in 3DS.
2 Soft 3DS Processing transactions with cards enrolled in 3DS.
3 No 3DS Processing transactions by skipping card 3DS verification at all.
4 Hard 3DS Processing transactions only with full 3DS verification the cardholder.

mitParentTransactionId.description: Transaction ID of the initial MIT transaction

mitMessageReasonCode.description:

Scheme Code Description
Mastercard ps Partial Shipment
Mastercard in Installment
Mastercard so Standing Order (variable amount, fixed frequency)
Mastercard sf Subscription (fixed amount, fixed frequency)
Mastercard uco Unscheduled Credential On File
Visa inc Incremental Authorization Transaction
Visa rea Reauthorization Transaction
Visa, Mastercard res Resubmission Transaction
Visa, Mastercard del Delayed Charges Transaction
Visa, Mastercard ns No Show Transaction

The unique cryptogram that is generated to validate the authorized use of the token for secure remote payments.
Optionally, the parameter can be provided together with 3DS data. Also, the parameter can be provided together with recurring/MIT (Merchant Initiated Transaction) parameters. For MIT (not subsequent), either 3DS or token, or both, are necessary.
The content of this field must be passed unmodified when provided by the Digital Wallet.
